canonical_example.text: De soldaat begon te schieten toen hij de vijand zag.
canonical_example.translation: The soldier began to shoot when he saw the enemy.

meanings.translation: a shot; the projectile; the range

canonical_example.text: Hij schoot door de gang om de trein te halen.
canonical_example.translation: He rushed through the corridor to catch the train.

canonical_example.text: De voetballer schoot de bal in het doel.
canonical_example.translation: The soccer player kicked the ball into the goal.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to kick (a ball in ball games, especially soccer)

canonical_example.text: De jager schoot een hert tijdens het jachtseizoen.
canonical_example.translation: The hunter shot a deer during hunting season.

unused_menu_senses.translation: a shot, some liquid (especially liquor) poured in one movement
a raised patch of sandy soil jutting out from the lowlands

canonical_example.text: De Madonna met het kindje Jezus op haar schoot wordt "zetel der Wijsheid" genoemd.
canonical_example.translation: The Madonna with baby Jesus on her lap is called the "seat of Wisdom".

unused_menu_senses.translation: various corresponding parts of certain vestments, animals and objects

canonical_example.text: Want U hebt mijn nieren geschapen, mij in de schoot van mijn moeder geweven.
canonical_example.translation: For you formed my inmost being; you knit me together in my mother's womb.

unused_menu_senses.translation: a divider that partitions a larger space into smaller ones (traditionally wooden planks, but could be made of any materials)

canonical_example.text: In een heet bad kon ze eindelijk ontspannen
canonical_example.translation: In a hot bath she could finally relax

canonical_example.text: Ga maar even liggen en probeer al je spieren helemaal to ontspannen.
canonical_example.translation: Lie down and try to untense all your muscles.

unused_menu_senses.translation: a leg of a piece of furniture
a stall, notably as a vending place on a market
a stable, a place to keep hoofed animals
a pool of horses, racers etc. owned or managed by a same person or entity
to put an animal in a stable
to park (any human-powered vehicle, such as a bicycle)

unused_menu_senses.context: obsolete or dialectal, of animals, particularly horses

source_metadata.context: obsolete or dialectal, of animals, particularly horses

meanings.translation: a student at an institute for secondary or tertiary education.

unused_menu_senses.translation: a student at an institute for academic tertiary education

canonical_example.text: De postbode zal het pakketje morgen bezorgen bij uw huis.
canonical_example.translation: The mailman will deliver the package to your house tomorrow.

canonical_example.text: Het restaurant kan een heerlijke maaltijd bezorgen voor uw feest.
canonical_example.translation: The restaurant can provide a delicious meal for your party.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to provide for, to care for
a long feather of a bird

canonical_example.text: Zou je even de deur voor me dicht willen doen?
canonical_example.translation: Could you please close the door for me (for a moment)?

meanings.translation: for a moment; modal particle indicating that the speaker expects that something will require little time or effort.

canonical_example.text: Ik zal even voor u kijken.
canonical_example.translation: I shall have a look for you shortly.

canonical_example.text: In de tweede helft van de 19e eeuw bloeide Vollenhove weer even op.^(nl:Vollenhove#Geschiedenis)
canonical_example.translation: In the second half of the 19th century, Vollenhove flourished again for a while.

meanings.translation: for a short period, for a while

canonical_example.text: In het midden van de vloer stond een tafel van wel vier meter hoog en een even grote stoel er bij.
canonical_example.translation: In the middle of the floor there stood a four-metre tall table and a chair just as large beside it.

unused_menu_senses.translation: just as, to the same degree

canonical_example.text: Die is even kwaad!
canonical_example.translation: He's rather angry!

meanings.translation: a T-shirt or other shirt, typically including undershirts

canonical_example.text: De dinsdagen zijn altijd mijn langste dagen op werk.
canonical_example.translation: The Tuesdays are always my longest workdays.

canonical_example.text: De leraar stelde een moeilijke vraag.
canonical_example.translation: The teacher stated a difficult question.

meanings.translation: to state, to put forward (a question or problem)

canonical_example.text: Deze ontwikkeling stelt ons voor een moeilijk dilemma.
canonical_example.translation: This development places us before a difficult dilemma.

canonical_example.text: Stel dat we naar Mars kunnen reizen.
canonical_example.translation: Suppose that we can travel to Mars.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to suppose (commonly as an imperative and followed by a clause beginning with dat)

canonical_example.text: De laborant stelde de oplossing op punt door titratie.
canonical_example.translation: The laboratory assistant standardized the solution by titration.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to standardize a solution by titration

canonical_example.text: Wat een vieze kerel!
canonical_example.translation: What a dirty guy!

meanings.translation: dirty, also in a sexual sense

canonical_example.text: Dit is een vies gerecht!
canonical_example.translation: This dish tastes bad!

canonical_example.text: Al die vieze potten en pannen hier, bah!
canonical_example.translation: All those dirty pots and pans here, bleh!

canonical_example.text: Ik ben vies van kaas.
canonical_example.translation: I don't like cheese.

unused_menu_senses.translation: disgusted by, not liking or shunning something

meanings.translation: a subject, discipline, class, notably in education

unused_menu_senses.translation: a compartment (e.g. a shelf, a section)
